sentences: You write Python every day. Here is the same work in Neovim, without reaching for the mouse.
Move through code by meaning: whole blocks, words, and the exact line you want.
Warnings show up as you type, and one key fixes them.
Run your tests from the file, and see each failure on the line that failed.
Debug with conditional breakpoints, and every variable in view.
Stop a live Django request right inside your view.
Call your API and query the database, without leaving the editor.
Each of these has its own short chapter below. One command installs it.

cards.label: Neovim for Python developers
cards.title: Code, test and debug by keyboard
cards.problem: A Neovim setup for people who write Python every day: language server, tests, debugger, API calls and SQL, one key each.
cards.before: An editor, a terminal, Postman and a database client, and the mouse to move between them.
cards.after: One editor for code, tests, debugging, API calls and SQL. Every action on a key, with its name on screen.
